title: Documentation gap
description: Designers are not documenting their process, decisions, or reasoning. Without this, knowledge cannot be shared, transferred, or built upon.

title: AI and meaning
description: AI is generating outputs that bypass the thinking process. The danger lies less in the tool and more in designers ceasing to ask why.

title: Saudi culture as material
description: Untapped potential in cultural heritage, from woodwork and craft to poetry and narrative, as source material for contemporary design.

title: Financial literacy
description: Designers struggle to quantify the value they create. The financial aspect is identified as a major structural weakness in the industry.

title: Speed vs depth
description: The development timeline moves at a pace that makes deep research and documentation difficult.

title: The charity perception
description: Consumers often view buying from local designers as an act of charity rather than a choice based on desire or product quality.

title: Meaning vs the sake of it
description: How can design move beyond designing for the sake of it toward meaning grounded in narrative, evidence, factors, and constraints?

title: The teachable unknown
description: How can visual judgement and composition be taught when there is no clear rule for what makes a composition pleasing?

title: Born or taught
description: How do skill, technique, receptiveness, analysis, and life experience interact in the development of design mastery?

title: Value engineering reality
description: How can designers protect value and influence clients when budget and time constraints push back against an ideal design?

title: JOMO: The Joy of Missing Out
description: A counter-movement to sensory overload, with design turning toward simplicity, smaller groups, and genuine human connection over mass appeal.

title: From buzzwords to real language
description: Practitioners are abandoning borrowed jargon and arriving with their own vocabulary, explaining what they actually mean.

title: Research replaces focus groups
description: A move away from focus groups toward research groups and feedback loops, evidence and lived experience over assumption.

title: Personalisation at scale
description: Mass products and environments engineered to feel made-for-you, raising questions about the personal inside the mass.

title: Designing for the senses
description: Sound, light, and smell moving from afterthought to the core of experience design.

title: Human scale over the bombastic
description: A turn toward developments that knit into existing urban fabric rather than spectacle for its own sake.

title: The end of import consulting
description: A shift away from generic imported best practice toward authentic local identity and capability built from within.

title: A safe space to fail
description: The need for room to sketch, experiment, take risks, and make mistakes so a design culture can mature through iteration.

title: Roles in flux
description: New functions and job titles are appearing faster than the institutions around them can stabilise.

title: Saudi heritage as source
description: Craft, literature, poetry, and material traditions translated into contemporary graphic, spatial, and narrative design.

title: Gaming as a methodology
description: Gaming logic, interaction design, and systems thinking applied across architecture, education, and public space.

title: AI as process, not output
description: Using AI to sort data, generate questions, and stress-test thinking instead of treating it primarily as a finished-output generator.

title: Advisory Board Research 01
description: Recorded facilitated discussion examining cross-disciplinary exchange, programme conditions, future topics, and design-sector questions.

title: Advisory Board Research 02
description: Recorded facilitated discussion examining research, documentation, AI, cultural knowledge, skill development, value, and KoD outcomes.

title: KoD × SXSW London Research Dialogue
description: Recorded critical dialogue on agency, originality, experimentation, making, public life, time, and local-global knowledge.
author_or_source: Brandie Janow; Harry Dobbs; Paulo Pimentel

title: Strategic Advisory Research
description: Recorded advisory research examining evidence quality, authenticity, data, sector development, sustainability, and long-term direction.

title: Creative-Sector Challenges Research
description: Recorded advisory research testing questions around people, infrastructure, institutions, data gaps, production, operating conditions, and continuity.

title: Past Speaker Feedback / Third Edition Planning
description: Recorded and fully coded research on KoD value, audience, format, theme comprehension, applied programming, knowledge continuity, mentoring, sector barriers, and possible measures.

title: Agency
description: Ability to frame questions, exercise judgment, and influence direction.

title: Original Practice
description: Inquiry, observation, and the confidence to create beyond familiar references.

title: Experimentation
description: Testing, critique, revision, and learning through process before outcomes become fixed.

title: Material Capacity
description: Tools, skills, production knowledge, facilities, suppliers, and making processes that connect ideas with use.

title: Public Life Over Time
description: Encounter, evaluation, feedback, shared standards, and continued development across time.
